feedback.user_feedback: Make the FSD strictly evidence-based, properly scoped, and aligned to the source code, no unsupported claims, no promotional language, no placeholders.
corrections: No duplicate headers/content blocks; keep single consolidated sections.
Replace placeholder text ('TODO', 'TBD', 'Content generation failed') with actual content.
No quantified claims (percentages, metrics) unless source is cited.
Use stable naming for entities and rules; don't mix business and technical details.
Tie each claim to a citation (code); remove unverified assertions.
improvements_requested: Add TOC and enforce consistent heading hierarchy (## sections, ### subsections).
Follow template order: Summary → Overview → Capabilities → Workflows → Rules → Data → Interfaces → Glossary.
No promotional language; use professional, factual tone only.
